name: Tasimelteon
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: CYP1A2/CYP3A4 mediate oxidation and oxidative dealkylation, including ring opening and carboxylic-acid formation. Glucuronidation follows; elimination is mainly urinary as metabolites.
